reasoning: Shows a classic video camera glyph enclosed inside a screen frame, universally understood as video calling, screen recording, or a video file. It fits a wide range of common personal and work tasks (Zoom calls, Loom recordings, video editing, watching lectures), though it closely overlaps with unframed video camera and movie player icons.
